semsetup_lead: Choose who reviews, what to review and how; check the impact and context preview before anything is sent to the model.
semsetup_mode_full_hint: every file of the repository, minus the exclusions
semsetup_mode_selected_hint: paths, folders, globs or subsystems you name
semsetup_mode_incremental_hint: what changed between a base and a target, with the dirty inputs you choose
semsetup_base_hint: A Git reference to compare from (required).
semsetup_dirty: Uncommitted changes of the working tree
semsetup_exclusions_hint: Globs never examined nor read as context, one per line.
semsetup_baseline: Reuse evidence of the latest semantic review
semsetup_baseline_hint: only units whose evidence still holds after current checks
semsetup_attach_quality: Attach the Quality run {runId} as evidence
semsetup_attach_quality_hint: optional; it is shown with its freshness and never approves anything by itself
semsetup_est_to_examine_value: {examine} to examine of {subjects} subjects ({files} files in the repository)
semsetup_est_context_value: {files, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}, about {kb} KB
semsetup_est_reserve_value: {calls} calls ({percent}%) kept for validation before hunting
semsetup_pv_methods_separate: Each method runs as its own semantic review, in this order; the first one opens when you start.
semsetup_pv_not_applicable_hint: A method that is not applicable still starts: it sends nothing and ends unavailable with this reason, never approved.
semsetup_problem_subjects: Name at least one path or subsystem for a selected scope.
semsetup_problem_base: An incremental review needs a base reference.
semsetup_problem_dirty: Name the uncommitted paths to include, or choose another option.
semsetup_problem_number_maxCalls: Maximum model calls: use a whole number, 0 or more.
semsetup_problem_number_maxTokens: Maximum tokens: use a whole number, 0 or more.
semsetup_problem_number_maxFiles: Context files: use a whole number, 0 or more.
semsetup_problem_number_maxDepth: Import depth: use a whole number, 0 or more.
semsetup_problem_number_maxBytes: Context bytes: use a whole number, 0 or more.
semprov_title: Who will do the AI review?
semprov_lead: Choose an agent already on your computer or an API with a key. The choice applies to this project and is saved in {file}.
semprov_locked: Governed mode: the policy {policy} fixes the configuration, so the provider is not changed here.
semprov_cli_lead: They use the login you already did in the CLI itself. No key: JGates never reads or stores credentials.
semprov_api_lead: Billed per use on your provider account. The key stays in the user's vault, outside the project.
semprov_checking: Checking whether it is installed and logged in…
semprov_login_needed: Installed, but not logged in. Click Log in.
semprov_unknown: Installed. The login could not be confirmed: if you already logged in, you can use it; otherwise click Log in.
semprov_unknown_timeout: Installed, but it took too long to say whether it is logged in. If you already logged in, you can use it; otherwise click Log in.
semprov_unknown_gemini: Installed. Gemini CLI has no status command: if you already logged in, you can use it; otherwise click Log in.
semprov_install_how: To install {name}, run this in a terminal, then click Check again:
semprov_login_opened: A terminal running {command} was opened. Finish the login there and come back to this window: it is checked again by itself.
semprov_login_copy: A terminal could not be opened. Run this command, finish the login and come back to this window:
semprov_copy_failed: Could not copy; select the command and copy it by hand.
semprov_api_no_key: Uses no key. It must be running at {url}.
semprov_api_setup: Needs a base URL before it can be used.
semprov_api_setup_link: Set it up in Providers and keys
semprov_model_other_placeholder: exact name, as the provider expects it
semprov_model_free: None in the list; “{model}” will be used as typed.
semprov_model_combo_help: Type to filter the {count} models; a name outside the list works too. Empty uses the default.
semprov_models_none: {name} does not list models: use its default or type a name in Other….
semprov_models_problem: The models of {name} could not be listed: use the default or type a name in Other….
semprov_models_api: Models the API listed with your key ({count}).
semprov_models_api_none: Choose Other… and type the model name.
semprov_why_missing: Install {name} first (see how on its card).
semprov_why_login: Log in to {name} first: click Log in on its card.
semprov_why_setup: Set the base URL of this API first.
semprov_why_checking: Wait for the check to finish.
semprov_why_model: Choose a model or type its name.
semprov_current_unknown: jgates.yml uses “{provider}”, which is not in this list. Choose a provider above to change it.
semprov_defaults_note: Keys, default models and connections apply to every project:
semprov_blocker: Nobody is set to do the review yet.
semprov_settings_fix: Fix it in the semantic gate card
